title: Howard Hughes brought to the Bahamas

tellings.quote: the the island there. And you also have Howard Hughes, who suddenly gets brought down there.

plain: The billionaire Howard Hughes is said to have been "suddenly" brought to an island in the Bahamas. The researcher Jason Simosa tells Michels this without naming a source, as one link in a chain he draws between the UFO cover-up and a secret society. He doesn't spell out what Hughes's move would mean, beyond placing him on that island alongside other people and events in his account.
